# Sample branch `sample-shop`

Synthetic fixtures for a local try. Not a customer. Not a ServiceTitan or ProBooks tenant.

- `office/` is the office shadow (`npm run shadow:office`). It has no field flags.
- `field/` is the field shadow (`npm run shadow:field`). Flags, time cards, coverage, and pins stay in this folder.

Aziel Eliab is the author of the software. He is not the operator of this sample and is not running a pilot.
